n = int(input())

K = 10**9 + 7
group_vectors = [[] for _ in range(9)]
popcount_counts = [0] * (1 << n)
probabilities = [0] * n
temp = [0] * n
dp_map = [dict() for _ in range(n + 1)]

for idx_i in range(1 << n):
    idx_j = bin(idx_i).count('1')
    popcount_counts[idx_i] = len(group_vectors[idx_j])
    group_vectors[idx_j].append(idx_i)

dp_map[0][1] = 1

for idx_i in range(n):
    probs_input = list(map(int, input().split()))
    for j in range(n):
        probabilities[j] = probs_input[j] * 570000004 % K

    for state, value in list(dp_map[idx_i].items()):
        for k in range(n):
            temp[k] = 0
        for m in group_vectors[idx_i]:
            if ((state >> popcount_counts[m]) & 1) != 0:
                for j in range(n):
                    if ((m >> j) & 1) == 0:
                        temp[j] |= (1 << popcount_counts[m | (1 << j)])
        for msk in range(1 << n):
            X = 1
            M = 0
            for j in range(n):
                if ((msk >> j) & 1) != 0:
                    M |= temp[j]
                    X = (X * probabilities[j]) % K
                else:
                    X = (X * (K - probabilities[j]) + K) % K
            dp_map[idx_i + 1][M] = (dp_map[idx_i + 1].get(M, 0) + value * X) % K

print(dp_map[n].get(1, 0))
